meta.title: Daniel Dobrovolskiy — Full-Stack & AI Engineer
meta.description: Daniel Dobrovolskiy is a full-stack software engineer in Austin, TX building production AI systems: RAG and semantic search, agentic workflows with LangGraph and FastAPI, and serverless pipelines on AWS. Founder of DramaRama.

items.name: GenAI & Retrieval
items.blurb: RAG and semantic search pipelines: embeddings, vector search on OpenSearch, indexing and ranking, LangChain and LangGraph, LLM tool calling, structured outputs, streaming, prompt and context engineering, guardrails and grounding.

items.name: Agentic Systems
items.blurb: Multi-agent orchestration: router and specialist agents, serverless fan-out pipelines, LLM-judged guardrails, per-call traces with replayable sessions, and per-user token budgets.

items.name: Backend & Data
items.blurb: Python and FastAPI, Java and Spring Boot, PostgreSQL and SQL, REST and WebSockets. Data ingestion from S3 to Postgres, rules engines, versioned migrations, pytest.

items.name: Frontend
items.blurb: TypeScript, React and Next.js (App Router), Redux, Tailwind and Bootstrap, headless CMS content via GraphQL (Hygraph), Clerk authentication.

items.name: Cloud & Security
items.blurb: AWS Lambda, S3, EventBridge, DynamoDB, EC2 and SAM infrastructure-as-code; Docker, CI/CD, serverless and microservices. RBAC, tenant isolation, JWT/OAuth, pen-test remediation.

items.name: AI-Assisted Engineering
items.blurb: Modular agentic coding workflows in Claude Code, Codex and Devin: shared context, templates, and tests written before the code so AI-generated changes meet agreed behavior. Team AI Champion.

about.title: About
about.heading: About Me
paragraphs: I'm a full-stack software engineer in Austin, TX. Since 2025 most of my work has been production AI systems: retrieval over large structured and unstructured datasets, agentic workflows with validation steps and guardrails, and the orchestration around them. Before that I built secure multi-tenant compliance software, moved Spring Boot services to AWS, and shipped websites for small businesses.

At Baker Tilly I'm lead developer of a compliance platform for Inflation Reduction Act tax-credit programs (Python, PostgreSQL, S3-to-Postgres ingestion, a penalty-calculating rules engine, RBAC and tenant isolation) and the team's AI Champion: I design the test-first, human-in-the-loop AI workflows that take a ticket from requirements to QA, and run Lunch & Learns on new tooling. At Neurohive I built agentic RAG for a global oil and gas company with LangGraph and a serverless multi-agent pipeline on Lambda, EventBridge and OpenSearch.

The idea I have carried since I was fifteen is an app that can tell where your thinking is stuck and help you get unstuck. I learned to program in order to build it. It is now DramaRama: twelve advisor agents and an orchestrator on FastAPI, Claude and Next.js, with LLM-judged guardrails and replayable session traces, tested in person with users in Austin.

timeline.text: First programs: Python coursework, then C# with .NET and a WPF Asteroids game.
Freelance web work begins: Tetris in vanilla JavaScript, then React, Redux and MobX. First client sites, including a custom WordPress theme.
Optimal Exterior rebuilt in React; SkyCity Trucking started. Contract at JPMorgan Chase: Spring Boot microservices to AWS with Docker and CI/CD, React UIs.
Client sites in React and Next.js with Hygraph headless CMS: RCheban Towing, United Homes, V&Y Horizon, Accellence Craft, Evolution Gaming. Fantum React Native app.
Baker Tilly: lead developer of a multi-tenant compliance platform in Python and PostgreSQL. DramaRama repository started.

Appointed Team AI Champion. Contract AI engineer at Neurohive: agentic RAG with LangGraph, serverless multi-agent pipeline on AWS, semantic search on OpenSearch. DramaRama founded (Whimsy & Rigor LLC).
DramaRama live and in user testing. Documentation-grounded chatbot and an LLM tracing workbench at Baker Tilly. True Reach, a deduplicated PR-reach calculator (FastAPI, Next.js).
